en:
That big wall... What if it's keeping us safe
from the titans...?
Well, I guess that wouldn't happen.

I'll stop fantasizing now. I need to think of
ways to survive the time limit instead.

But...I don't think I can come up 
with anything, though...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time thinking of ideas
with Tsumugi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
